prompt: High-fidelity desktop web app login screen comp, 1440x1024 landscape, for NEXORA, an enterprise procurement and order-to-cash operations platform. This is composition option A within a fixed commercial chain-of-custody command ledger design world. Exact structure: asymmetric 58/42 split. Left 58% is a calm deep-navy operational ledger surface with small NEXORA logo top-left, a large clear statement Every commercial decision, connected to its evidence., then a real-looking synthetic workflow demonstration showing one customer enquiry moving through Email captured → Lead reconciled → Partial bid approved → RFQ promoted → Order fulfilled → Payment posted. Render it as one continuous precise custody line with dated compact stages, source-document references, approved 8 of 12 lines, and subtle status marks. Right 42% is a warm-white sign-in workspace with theme icon top-right, heading Sign in to Nexora, explanatory line, accessible Email address and Password fields with visible resting borders, password reveal, Forgot password link, large blue Sign in button, and a quiet bottom link Platform administration. Enterprise, assured, crisp, restrained, operational, high information quality. Palette: deep navy #0B172A, white #FFFFFF, cool paper #F5F7FA, governed blue #1F6FEB, success teal #087F73, amber only for blocked state. Fine 1px rules, 6-10px corner radii, restrained elevation, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no floating orbit icons, no scanner line, no fake customer logos, no invented performance claims. Typography should feel like a modern transport manifest and financial control room: workhorse sans, tabular numerals, strong but not oversized headings. The UI itself must dominate; not a poster or illustration.
approvalBasis: Delegated by the user to the CTO role; selected because it makes Nexora's unique evidence-to-cash mechanism legible immediately while keeping authentication dominant and truthful.
